decisions.reason: Changing the inaugural issue from November to December does not alter the author-name, author-photo identity, source, or placement requirements.
The polished, modern, brand-aligned visual style remains required for the inaugural issue regardless of its revised month.
The month change does not alter the requirement to enhance low-quality publication images when necessary.
The issue-month change does not replace or modify the Civic Lantern website as the article-content source.
Advertisements must still render clearly; the source decision changes publication timing metadata, not advertisement quality.
The category-label rules and existing article-to-category mappings are independent of the issue month.
Moving the inaugural issue to December does not change the requirement to eliminate empty white areas at article endings.
The source does not cancel, replace, or otherwise change the articles required to keep the issue consistent with its cover.
The issue still requires cohesive layout assembly using the latest Flat Plan; only its publication month and date metadata changed.
The template remains required for the inaugural issue and contains no month-specific state requiring modification.
The source does not remove or relocate the supplied tribute page; changing the issue month leaves its inclusion requirement unchanged.
The revised issue month does not alter the required circular shape or small size of author photos.
